_comment: Default vehicle configurations for EcoRoute Optimizer. Load factor multiplies consumption (1.0 = base unladen/standard load).

petrol_hatchback.name: Petrol Hatchback
petrol_hatchback.notes: Standard hatchback profile. Real-world urban driving is typically 15-20% lower than certified cycles.

diesel_suv.name: Diesel SUV
diesel_suv.notes: Mid-to-large diesel SUV. Diesel has higher volumetric carbon content (2.68 kg CO2/L vs 2.31 for petrol).

electric_car.name: Electric Car
electric_car.notes: Compact/sedan EV. Zero tailpipe emissions; lifecycle CO2 based on national grid average (0.82 kg CO2/kWh).

diesel_delivery_van.name: Diesel Delivery Van
diesel_delivery_van.notes: Light commercial vehicle with freight/payload load factor (1.25).
